contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ [--]NS NOB CAES ; R/ [GLORIA EXERC] ITVS

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Constans (333-350), as kindly identified by the finder, Gloria Exercitus issue of 336-340, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Youthful bust possibly laureate draped and possibly cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: [--]NS NOB CAES. Reverse description: Two soldiers with one standard between them. Reverse inscription: [GLORIA EXERC] ITVS. Diameter: 15.1mm, Weight: 1.14gms, die axis: 6
